name: find_notes
description: Discover passages by topic/text; result=notes returns one representative passage per note and requires activity_range. Previews need reading with read_notes purpose=answer before citation. Use returned IDs/folders, never topics as folders. For recorded activity use include_history and activity_range; timestamps, backlog and note counts do not establish work. Ranges filter text changes, not deadlines or event dates: omit them to find events in unchanged/later-authored text. For current deadlines try literal @due. Continue with cursor only; result and filters are retained.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

include_history.description: Include retained added/removed, even superseded lines. Requires activity_range; not current status. With query use literal/regex.

query.description: Match content; history matches changed text, not titles. Omit for all activity, then narrow by returned noteId.

result.description: Default passages; notes groups recorded activity by note and requires activity_range. Omit on continuation.

name: read_notes
description: purpose=answer: Read evidence IDs or a known canonical note; continue with purpose and cursor only. Cite exact returned [S#] references; the app builds links. activity_range assesses temporal support separately from meaning: qualify uncertainty; never attribute not_established passages or supporting context to that period. Resolve actor, event date, negation and status. Coverage excludes cleared history and discarded Editing Window states; it is not a complete real-world record. purpose=edit: Read bounded working-copy pages for reviewed changes; lines are 1-based. pendingChanges is unapproved content, not answer evidence. Use returned contentHash when proposing changes.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

include_provenance.description: Default false. Expand only for lineage; validation, timing and activitySupport are always included.

note_id.description: Known canonical note ID; bounded current pages, no pending proposals.

name: propose_note_change
description: Stage a reviewed change; the user must Keep before disk changes. operation=edit applies targeted edits to a surfaced note. replace supplies its complete body: first read every current purpose=edit page in this run, including pendingChanges; retain all desired content and omit managed frontmatter. Both fold pending content into the combined preview. create stages a uniquely named new note. Submit through this tool. Deadlines: @due(YYYY-MM-DD), Gregorian years 0001-9999, on the exact checkbox line. Preserve unrelated/child text; when changing/removing a deadline consolidate only supported valid annotations on that line. No stored slash commands, due times or reminders.

contextAfter.description: Exact following anchor for insert/replace; omit for append/prepend.

contextBefore.description: Exact preceding anchor for insert/replace; omit for append/prepend.

kind.description: append/prepend: document boundaries. replace: exact oldText. insert: exact, unique contextBefore/contextAfter anchors.

oldText.description: Exact nonempty text for replace; otherwise omit.

markdown.description: Complete replacement body including all retained content; no managed frontmatter.

name: research_notes
description: Gather a focused remaining gap with a bounded worker sharing this run's provider/model, scope and budgets. Prefer direct reads for known passages; preserve allowance for other work. Returned passages are validated, already-read evidence: cite directly; on partial delivery read only remainingEvidenceIds. Follow direct-evidence recovery on failure. One worker at a time; repeat only for a different gap/scope. Returns selected passages, not its transcript. Cannot write, use web or delegate.

end.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

start.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD local date or RFC3339 timestamp with UTC offset.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for local dates; defaults to the run's supplied timezone.

folder.description: Known vault-relative path only; never infer from topics.

note_ids.description: Known note IDs only; omit for discovery.

name: update_plan
description: Publish or update a concise user-visible plan for multi-step work. Do not include hidden reasoning. Re-send the full plan whenever a step changes.
